Title: Failed login clears Password but preserves Email/Username

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/login
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "email": "admin@parabank.com",
  "password": "WrongPass1!"
}

Preconditions:
  A registered user exists; entered password will be incorrect (admin@parabank.com / WrongPass1!)

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter 'admin@parabank.com' in Email/Username
  2. Enter 'WrongPass1!' in Password
  3. Click Sign In

Expected Result:
  Error "Incorrect email or password." is shown; Password field is cleared; Email/Username retains the entered value; form allows retry

  Placeholders filled: using the seeded user's email and an incorrect password to exercise failed-login behavior. DOM verification confirmed required inputs and submit button exist; post-failure state must be validated at runtime.
